fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Sends a swell at the first enemy in a line up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Full Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 iron balls at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Trimmed Sails
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Tailwind
fusions.desc: When you travel a good distance, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
